description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeActionSummaryDao class, which extends a base data access object. It contains methods to query and count various employee-related actions such as scheduled interviews, pending reviews, and self-reviews within an HRM system. The class utilizes query builders to interact with entities like CandidateVacancy, PerformanceReview, and Reviewer, and applies filtering based on statuses and employee properties.

classes.name: EmployeeActionSummaryDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for retrieving counts of employee actions and reviews related to HR activities such as interviews and performance reviews within the HRM system.

methods.name: getActionableScheduledInterviewCount
methods.description: Counts the number of scheduled interviews for a list of candidate IDs, filtering by candidate status and vacancy activity.

methods.name: getPendingAppraisalReviewCount
methods.description: Returns the count of pending appraisal reviews based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getPendingSelfReviewCount
methods.description: Returns the count of self-reviews pending for an employee, filtered by review statuses and employee number.
